    How this quiz works

    Site quizzes include only species marked X in that site’s column. “Entire trip checklist” includes every species, including species without an X at any site. Lifer filters compare with your eBird export as of October 7, 2026. Colombia lifers include worldwide lifers. These are potential lifers based on your exported records, rather than the spreadsheet’s bold and italic formatting.

    Scientific names were reconciled for 13 checklist spelling errors. The original spreadsheet is unchanged. Photos are sourced exclusively from the Macaulay Library and credited to their contributors. Internet access is needed to load them. With All families selected, question sets contain distinct species. “Use all eligible species” sets the question count automatically for the current filters and selected medium, and includes each playable species once even with a family selected. Annotation review instead includes all eligible unreviewed photos. When you select a specific family, species may repeat with different photos; each photo is used at most once per quiz. If you request more questions than the available species or photos, the quiz uses the entire available pool.

    Regular and review answers are remembered by species and medium in this browser, except when experimental ID tips are enabled. Experimental sessions do not change statistics or recent mistake history, even for species without tips. Recent review uses each species’ last 20 attempts in the selected medium and includes it only when more than 25% were missed. Review quizzes ignore lifer filters and show each eligible species once, using available media in that medium. The end-of-quiz review includes every species missed in that quiz, even when its overall miss rate is 25% or less. Start over resets quiz settings, while keeping your learning history.

    Audio practice and geographic limits

    Loading recording coverage…

    Audio questions use Macaulay Library vocalizations. We prefer a recording from the named site area, then the same department, then Colombia, then a broader fallback. This preference searches only our current catalog. A department may span different slopes, habitats, and elevations. We have not verified site subspecies assignments or subspecies matches; proximity alone is not proof of a match. The exact, regional, or fallback basis, contributor, source link, location, sound type when known, and subspecies limitations are shown after answering.

    All-sites scope spans several regions. The high- and mid-elevation Montezuma scopes currently share a general-area preference; recording elevation has not been matched. Bellavista’s precise location remains unresolved and uses country-level fallbacks. A recording may contain background species, calls rather than song, or only part of a species’ repertoire. Catalog identity and geographic metadata are verified, but every clip has not been auditioned for clarity. Species without verified recording records are excluded; the setup shows coverage. Recordings can become unavailable. Retry, or use the unscored skip for an unclear or unavailable recording.

    Press Play before submitting an audio answer; replaying does not create additional attempts. Identifying recording metadata is hidden until answering. Photo ID tips are for visual practice only. Visual and audio answers use separate browser histories, each retaining the last 20 scored attempts per species. Existing history remains visual. Review thresholds and statistics use only the selected medium.

    How these statistics are calculated

    Regular quizzes and mistake reviews count; sessions with experimental ID tips enabled do not. Each scored question counts once: correct IDs count as successes; wrong or revealed answers count as misses. Unscored skips and unavailable media do not count. Rates combine the answer counts, rather than averaging species percentages.

    With Site-only quizzes switched off, site rates cover every species marked X for that site using its answers from any quiz, so a species can contribute to several sites. With it switched on, only answers from quizzes scoped to that exact site with All families selected count, including site-scoped mistake reviews. The last 20 qualifying attempts per species are retained independently for each site. Both views are tracked regardless of the display switch. Older history has no site context and is included only in the all-scopes view. Family rates always cover all quiz scopes and sites. Visual and audio histories are separate; existing history belongs to visual practice. Your current quiz filters do not change these summaries. Progress is saved only in this browser, starting with the history-tracking update.
